body:
Ok, I've isolated the problem. My web app uses both Algolia instantsearch and Firebase. Both of these are loaded by two different .js files and I've tried to keep the functionality of both apart. However both files have separate `onload()` functions: the Algolia file uses the code above (`windows.onload`) and the Firebase file uses `document.ready`).

1. Are there any known issues to using both instantsearch and Firebase in the same app?
2. Might it be more feasible to combine the functions of these two files into one file, for example to combine the instantiation of both instantsearch and Firebase inside one `window.onload`?
